items.title: Allstate (ALL) Wins Analyst Support, Is It Still 6% Undervalued?
items.summary: Allstate (ALL) moved higher in the last session after a 1.88% gain, as investors responded to positive analyst estimate revisions even though upcoming quarterly earnings are expected to decline compared with the prior year. The latest move comes after a strong run, with Allstate’s share price delivering a 26.82% year to date gain and a 15.86% 3 month share price return. The 1 year total shareholder return of 33.82% reflects momentum that aligns with improving sentiment around future earnings...

items.title: Higher Rates Are a Gift to These 3 Insurance Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Insurance companies collect your premiums today and settle your claims years from now, and that gap is quietly becoming a profit engine as rates stay elevated. Three insurers are turning this float mechanic into dividend growth that outlasted a pandemic, an inflation shock, and back-to-back catastrophe years.
